# JM Estate — default build/delivery instructions

Read `AGENTS.md` and `coding-estate/LIVE_DIRECT_DOOR_LAW.md` before changing or delivering estate-hosted HTML/web bodies.

For JM Games&Beyond game work, also read `games-beyond/JM_GAME_STANDARD_BUILD_ORDER.md` before building or materially upgrading a game.

Default delivery law: **SOURCE → OPEN_FIRST → ESTATE MOUNT → LIVE PROOF → DIRECT DOOR**.

Default game-production law: **RECOVER / AUTHORITY → CORE PLAYABLE BODY → CONTROL + FIT → PRIMARY VISUAL BODY → PRESENTATION-ROUTE IDENTITY → WORLD / PROGRESSION CONSEQUENCE → MATERIAL / ENVIRONMENT → COMPOSITION / THEATRE → LIVING VISIBLE-STATE FEEDBACK → ESTATE CONFORMANCE → PRODUCT DEPTH → CURRENT VISUAL-CROWN / DEEP-HOUSE CONVERGENCE → REAL-CONTEXT PROOF → CLEAN PROMOTION → ESTATE MOUNT / LIVE CONTACT → OWNER CONTACT / COLD DING → DONATE THE LEARNING**.

PUKA is the proved reference lineage for this build order, not a theme/template to copy. Reuse the machinery and proof discipline without flattening game identity. Prefer full-complete jumps over cosmetic version churn.

For HTML/web descendants, present the proved live estate URL first. Sandbox/download/ZIP routes are fallback or archival only unless the owner explicitly requests them. Preserve source lineage, responsive fit, proof boundaries, and no-Ding/no-claim discipline.
